evidence: The SVD is the first model to beat degree clearly on degree-matched and hard negatives.
observation: The training target-disease matrix was factorised with IDF weighting and rank-averaged truncated SVDs at k = 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96; components were selected on a 20% slice of the training positives and the test split was left untouched. It beat degree on degree-matched and hard negatives but stayed below degree on fair random negatives, so a 70/30 degree+SVD blend was kept as a separate fair-protocol candidate.
subject: F-50
title: IDF-weighted target-disease SVD is the first honest model to beat degree
